title: Kerala’s ancient serpent-worship folk music comes alive in Delhi
The Sun was ‘eaten’, attacked and chased: How ancient cultures explained the mystery of solar eclipses and the beliefs that inspired fasting, silence and rituals
description: Throughout history, ancient societies interpreted solar eclipses as ominous events, often prompting elaborate rituals. Many thought that mythical beings devoured the sun, leading them to create noises in an attempt to frighten these creatures away. In Hindu lore, the demon Rahu explains eclipse phenomena, shaping rituals in Indian homes. Additionally, certain cultures embraced silence during these events, honoring the cosmic event's profound significance.
